newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian rebels kill nine in wave of attacks.
newsitem.headline: Colombian rebels kill nine in wave of attacks.

text.p: Leftist guerrillas killed at least nine people, including two members of the secret police and a special investigator, in attacks across Colombia on Monday, authorities said.

Rebels of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), the country's largest guerrilla army, attacked a group of officials from the regional prosecutor's office as they went to investigate reports of a murder near the town of Villeta, in central Cundinamarca province.
Two agents of the secret police, or DAS, died in the attack along with a member of the prosecutor's office, police said.

Four peasants were killed by suspected National Liberation Army (ELN) insurgents near the oil production centre of Barrancabermeja, in northeast Colombia. The motives for the attacks were not clear, a police spokesman said.

The third incident took place in northern Bolivar province when guerrillas detonated mines along a main highway, killing two civilians. Police said three more people travelling in the four-wheel drive truck were missing after the explosion, which appeared to have been aimed at a military convoy.
